seo.title: English Cocker Spaniel Puppies in Tuscany, Italy | Allevamento Cocker Montecorno
seo.description: English Cocker Spaniel puppies born in early October 2026, ready from mid-December. Next litter expected in January 2027 in Grosseto, Tuscany.

puppiesIntro: A new best friend isn’t chosen in a hurry. You meet, get to know each other. Then, one day, it just feels right.
careTitle:
Ready for life.
Together with you.
careText: Puppies join their families after 60 days of age, with thoughtful care and an introductory visit to our breeding home.

steps.heading: A conversation
steps.text: Tell us about your life, your routines, and your family.

steps.heading: A visit to Grosseto
steps.text: Come and meet us, and spend time with our cockers.

steps.heading: A new beginning
steps.text: We help you prepare for your puppy’s arrival at home.

europeTitle: A little Tuscany. Wherever you call home.
europeText: You’re welcome to write in English. We’ll plan your visit to Tuscany and discuss requirements for your country. For international travel, puppies may need to be older than 60 days.

faqs.question: When can a puppy join our family?
faqs.answer: The litter born in early October 2026 will be ready from mid-December 2026, following an introductory meeting. International travel must also meet the health requirements and rules of the destination country.

faqs.question: How do I check availability?
faqs.answer: Message Natascia on WhatsApp; we do not answer calls. The October 2026 litter includes orange and white and white-roan males, and golden females. The next litter is expected in January 2027, with black and white and orange and white colours.

faqs.question: What comes with a puppy?
faqs.answer: An ENCI/FCI pedigree, vaccinations, microchip, deworming, and parasite treatment. Natascia will explain the documents and care for your individual puppy.

nextLitter.label: THE NEXT CHAPTER
nextLitter.intro: Our next litter is expected in January 2027. A new beginning to look forward to, with the same thoughtful care.

nextLitter.note: Timing and colours are expected, not guaranteed. Message us on WhatsApp for updates.
